title: [BUG] when memory is enabled, flow is failing saying cannot pickle thread object
body:

TypeError: cannot pickle '_thread.RLock' object

### Steps to Reproduce

### Expected behavior

    def crew(self) -> Crew:

            agents=self.agents, # Automatically created by the @agent decorator
            tasks=self.tasks, # Automatically created by the @task decorator
            process=Process.sequential,
            memory=True,
            verbose=True,

### Operating System

### Python Version

### crewAI Version

1.3.0

linked_prs.title: fix: handle unpickleable values in flow state

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.

This is an agent issue because the error occurs when enabling memory in the agent system, specifically during memory initialization or content handling, resulting in a serialization (pickling) failure. It directly matches the "Memory initialization issues" and "Memory content errors" subcategories.
